gloss: enshrinement; laying to rest; placing (a body or sacred object)

definitions.gloss: enshrinement; placing a sacred object or statue
definitions.explanation: To place a Buddhist statue, sacred object, or religious artifact in a designated location for worship.

definitions.gloss: laying out a body; keeping a body before burial
definitions.explanation: To place a deceased person's body in a designated area before funeral rites are performed.

examples.japanese: {仏像|ぶつぞう}を{安置|あんち}する。
この{寺|てら}には{古|ふる}い{仏像|ぶつぞう}が{安置|あんち}されている。
examples.english: An ancient Buddhist statue is enshrined at this temple.

examples.japanese: {本堂|ほんどう}に{安置|あんち}されている{観音像|かんのんぞう}は{国宝|こくほう}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: The Kannon statue enshrined in the main hall is designated a national treasure.

examples.japanese: {遺体|いたい}を{安置|あんち}する。
{故人|こじん}は{葬儀場|そうぎじょう}に{安置|あんち}された。
examples.english: The deceased was laid to rest at the funeral home.

examples.japanese: {通夜|つや}まで{遺体|いたい}を{自宅|じたく}に{安置|あんち}することにした。
examples.english: We decided to keep the body at home until the wake.

notes: {安|あん} means peace/safety and {置|ち} means to place, so the word literally means to place peacefully. Used as a する verb: {安置|あんち}する. Sense 1 is common in descriptions of temples and shrines. Sense 2 is used in funeral and bereavement contexts. Collocations: {仏像|ぶつぞう}を{安置|あんち}する (enshrine a statue), {遺体|いたい}を{安置|あんち}する (lay out a body), {安置|あんち}{所|しょ} (resting place, mortuary).
